warnings: MEALS: All 3 days within the 30 EUR/person/day meal budget. Average 41.67 EUR/day for 2 people vs 120 EUR/day budget. Meals UNDER budget by 110 EUR total.
TRANSPORT: Taxi costs total 450 EUR for 2 people across 3 days — the single largest expense category after intercity trains.
Grand Ballon Day 1: Taxi is 180 EUR round-trip (62km each way). Consider replacing with closer hike to eliminate this cost.
Day 1 Ferme Auberge du Grand Ballon lunch: Timeline flags this as impossible before taxi departure — use picnic (16 EUR saves 20 EUR).
Day 2 Ferme Auberge du Frankenthal: Cash only. Bring 50 EUR cash minimum for lunch.
Day 3 TIMING CRITICAL: Only 51-min buffer at Remiremont for train connection. Do not be late.
Day 3 fishing permits: Purchase online BEFORE trip at cartedepeche.fr.
Day 3 Confiserie Geromoise: Timeline schedules at 06:30 — not open that early.
recommendations: SAVE 180 EUR: Replace Grand Ballon Day 1 with local hike near Gerardmer (e.g., Col de la Schlucht area, ~30 EUR taxi vs 180 EUR for Grand Ballon). Grand Ballon is 62km away.
SAVE 20 EUR: Use picnic lunch Day 1 (16 EUR) instead of Ferme Auberge du Grand Ballon restaurant (36 EUR) — also avoids timeline conflict.
SAVE 16-32 EUR: Skip after-hike drinks Day 1 and/or Day 2 (16 EUR each).
SAVE 28 EUR: Switch Day 3 lunch to picnic (8 EUR vs 36 EUR ferme-auberge) — also reduces timing pressure for train.
UPGRADE Day 3 dinner: Meal budget 33.50 EUR under per person — upgrade from train snacks (12 EUR) to sit-down dinner at Remiremont station restaurant.
BOOK IN ADVANCE: SNCF trains booked 4-6 weeks ahead can be significantly cheaper (Ouigo Paris-Nancy as low as 10-15 EUR).
